name: Digipower USA
old_description: Welcome to Digipower Chip Performance - 10% OFF in your first purchase. FREE GROUND SHIPPING!
about:
Digipower USA is based in Orlando, Florida, and operates an e-commerce business selling automotive performance parts under the DPW, Speed Infinity, and VORTEX1 brands. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not disclosed in the available sources.

The product lineup centers on exhaust cutout kits, throttle response controllers, and turbo performance tuners for a range of Ford, Chevrolet, and other vehicle platforms. Items such as the DPW Exhaust Cutout EVO Kit (2.5" and 3" sizes), the Speed Infinity Throttle Response Controller, and the VORTEX1 Turbo Performance Tuner are listed with pricing and customer reviews. No facility size, headcount, production volumes, or part-number counts are provided.

Customers include individual vehicle owners and at least one retail channel: a review notes purchasing a DPW cutout kit from a Summit Racing retail store. Industries served are automotive aftermarket and performance upgrades, with concrete examples covering Ford F-150 EcoBoost, Raptor, Mustang, Chevrolet Camaro, Silverado, and classic car applications.

The company emphasizes responsive technical support, Bluetooth/app-based control for its cutout systems, and free ground shipping on first purchases. No explicit statement about why the business was started or what sets it apart beyond support and connectivity features is present in the source material.
built_on: Free ground shipping on first order
capabilities: Exhaust cutout kit design and assembly
